description:
First Fellowship – Dragonfly Experience

The Rotary Club of Mumbai Rising Stars kicked off its fellowship calendar for RY 2026–27 with a lively evening at Dragonfly Experience, Mumbai, on 18th July 2026. The event witnessed an enthusiastic participation of 35 members, who came together to reconnect, unwind, and celebrate the beginning of the new Rotary year.

The evening was filled with great conversations, music, laughter, and camaraderie, setting a wonderful tone for the year ahead. The strong turnout reflected the enthusiasm and spirit of togetherness among our Rising Stars family.

A perfect start to a year of stronger bonds, greater participation, and memorable fellowships!
